rootDisposition.decision: Approved default take-home calculator replaces old documentation landing; documentation entry remains /start.

sharedRenderingAndSource: packages/docs-content source config/build adapter and authored inputs
preserve.historicalAndBinaryEvidence: Preserve all original historical receipts, source snapshots, screenshots, failed attempts and initial retention baseline unchanged.

ignoredOldAppEntries.decision: Leave all physically in place; no folder cleanup. Private metadata inventory contains no file contents.
ignoredOldAppEntries.boundary: Generated/untracked local files are not deployment evidence.

preserve.taxAndMetrics: Retained tax results and Medicare decision; collection disabled and metrics deferred.

retire.trackedAppSources: Only the 49 named original apps/docs files; replace its README with a truthful successor tombstone after source verification.
retire.currentBuildWiring: Remove the old app workspace and root build/test/dev aliases, app-specific Knip/lint selection and current routes to obsolete source.
retire.currentProviderWriters: Retire the old default Stack and old writer routes with a provider-free refusal; retain old resource identity and historical tool/receipt proof. Do not point old authority at native resources.

recovery.sourceOnly: Use the exact verified bundle for source inspection or an isolated reconstruction. The original Git revision retains full context; the bundle alone is not a complete rebuild/deploy checkout.
recovery.providerAuthority: No provider recovery granted. A future exact provider operation must be separately approved against its named original resource and source/artifact identity.

acceptancePostconditions: All 49 archived source texts, sizes and hashes match original Git bytes; strict native reconstruction and missing/tamper/size refusals pass.
Every accepted old page address has the same proved current Website destination; the approved root disposition is explicit.
No active old app workspace/build/source or writer dependency remains; missing current source never passes through an archive fallback.
Old entry/writer refusal occurs before credential fetch, remote state, plan or provider mutation; no successful empty graph exists.
Current owners, runbooks, exact controls, journey/history routes and permitted skill profiles agree; final full repository and release qualification pass.
nonClaims: Local source retirement is qualified; this does not establish default-branch or hosted replacement.
No complete historical rebuild, fresh deployed/provider state, exercised rollback, native provider operation, merge, deployment, publication, credential action or deferred metrics implementation.
oldOperationStartupLimit: The installed Alchemy CLI creates local logs and an empty default profile before Stack import. The static retirement marker refuses before session providers, remote state and planning; it does not promise zero local writes.
